Review queue — harvest CN-2021-2026

118 candidate events, generated 2026-11-17. Decide each one, export the decisions file, apply it with python -m pipeline.queue decide decisions-CN-2021-2026.json on this branch, and push. A move is a year-on-year intensification: form a new move only if the claimant's behaviour is new, more frequent or wider in scope than the previous year's moves shown beside each candidate; otherwise merge the event into the existing move it belongs to. Each card carries a pre-sort (presorted by claude-code/opus): a suggested decision with its reason, prefilled in the form where no draft exists; it is a suggestion, and the decision is yours.
